Two independent events A and B

We need to find P(A - B).

P(A - B) = P(A) - P(A ∩ B)

Since A and B are independent events:

P(A ∩ B) = P(A) × P(B)

Therefore, P(A - B) = P(A) - P(A) × P(B)

P(A - B) = P(A) - P(A) × P(B)

P(A - B) = P(A)(1 - P(B))
